温郗笑够了，足尖一点，向下一跃，绿裙在半空展开如一朵花。
萧杙下意识往前迎了半步，温郗却已经轻盈地落了地。
她冲他眨了眨眼，几片花瓣从她发间滑落，“温征跟我说我不在的时候你跟师父一直在岱舆山那陪着我。”
萧杙慌了一瞬，刚想解释什么，却不料温郗根本没多想，只是拍了拍他的肩膀道了谢。
“好兄弟，太仗义了。结果温征转头就说你们两个回青云道院有事要处理，所以我就回来了。”
“本来先回的清弦峰，但我师父不知道去哪里了，想来是有会要开吧，所以就来你这找你啦。”
“虞师叔……”萧杙想了想，“应该是在开有关风云大赛的会，不过我师父都回来了，想来虞师叔应当也已经回了清弦峰。”
听到“风云大赛”这四个字，温郗眯了眯眼睛，眼底有思绪闪过。
她早就不是新来的外世人了，自然知道这个风云大赛的概念，也知道赢下的必要。
毕竟，他们青云道院也是有自己要守的边界区域的，不少师姐师兄毕业后都选择去了那边，此次风云大赛的名次关乎着资源分配。
谁会嫌拿到的资源少呢？他们这边多整一点，那边的师姐师兄就能在凶残的战场上多一道保命的招数。
这可比道院内部的新生大赛有技术含量的多。
正想着呢，萧杙观察着温郗的脸色，还是没忍住开了口，“小郗，你知道自己昏迷了一年吗？”
“啊，我知道，温征跟我说了。”温郗应道。
温郗笑了笑，张开双手在萧杙面前转了一圈，“已经全好了，你还不相信两仪婆娑树的能力吗？”
两仪婆娑树不仅把她的经脉都修复好了，还顺道给她加固了下，温郗觉得自己的经脉坚韧宽阔了不少，真是得谢谢这一遭经历，也算因祸得福。

萧杙；“那就好，这昏迷的一年里，你有意识吗？有感到什么疼痛吗？”

他生怕温郗经脉复原的过程会有痛感。
“意识倒是有，”温郗点了点头，“只不过，都是一些莫名其妙的画面。”
不知想到了什么，温郗敛眸，嘴角的笑容缓缓收起。
她偏首望向远处的云雾，轻声道：“没什么，说起来，只不过是睡了一觉罢了。”
只是在那梦中，依稀看到了许多不该看到的画面……
片刻后，温郗视线微转，目光又落在了萧杙身上，脸上又重新染上了笑意——
温郗：“不说这个了，我刚刚见你打算锁院子，怎么……你这是，准备跑？”
温郗嘴角微微抽搐：“那我就好奇了，冷师伯不同意，你要怎么出青云道院？墨师叔的阵法又不是吃素的。”
萧杙眨眨眼：“师兄上次给我的请假条我还有剩。”
冷千双人忙，紫霄峰的琐事平常都是凌绝负责管理，他经常趁着让冷千双给正当玉简签字的时候把空白的出院申请单给一同递出去。
这么多年下来，凌绝手里压着的请假条得有一二百张，去年萧杙入千痕谷前，凌绝搂着他一把鼻涕一把泪地说“好师弟，来，师兄把这些都给你，你可一定要活着出来。”，随后萧杙的空间灵宝里就多了二百张出院申请单。
后来，萧杙的确是活着从千痕谷出来了，凌绝又扭扭捏捏地来找他。
“师弟啊我的好师弟，师兄承认当时有点太冲动了，这个请假条，你看，是不是，那什么……”
萧杙最终还回去了一百张，给自己留了一半。
而此刻，萧杙就这么毫不犹豫地把凌绝给卖了。
她还是得向师兄多学习，虽然师父根本不会让她有这种困扰。

Wen Xi smiled enough, and jumped down on his tiptoes. His green skirt spread out like a flower in the air.
Xiao Zhu subconsciously took half a step forward, but Wen Xi had already landed lightly on the ground.
She blinked at him, and a few petals fell from her hair, "Wen Zheng told me that you and Master have been staying with me at Daiyu Mountain while I was away."
Xiao Zhu panicked for a moment and was about to explain something, but unexpectedly, Wen Xi didn't think much about it and just patted him on the shoulder and thanked him.
"Good brother, you are so righteous. But Wen Zheng turned around and said that you two had something to deal with when you returned to Qingyun Taoist Temple, so I came back."
"I originally went back to Qingxian Peak first, but my master didn't know where he went. I guess he had a meeting to hold, so I came here to see you."
"Master Yu..." Xiao Yao thought for a while, "It should be a meeting about the Fengyun Competition, but my master is back, so I think Master Yu must have returned to Qingxian Peak as well."
Hearing the words "Wind and Cloud Competition", Wen Xi narrowed his eyes, and thoughts flashed through his eyes.
She is no longer a new outsider. She naturally knows the concept of this competition and the need to win.
After all, Qingyun Taoist Academy also has its own border area to guard. Many senior sisters and brothers have chosen to go there after graduation. The ranking of this Fengyun Competition is related to the allocation of resources.
Who would complain that the resources they received were few? If they are more careful here, the senior sisters and brothers over there will be able to use one more life-saving trick on the brutal battlefield.
This is much more technical than the freshman competition within the Taoist Academy.
Just as he was thinking about it, Xiao Yao observed Wen Xi's face and couldn't help but said, "Xiao Xi, do you know that you have been in a coma for a year?"
"Ah, I know, Wen Zheng told me." Wen Xi responded.
Wen Xi smiled, opened his hands and turned around in front of Xiao Yao, "It's all healed. Don't you still believe in the ability of the Liangyi Swirling Tree?"
The Liangyi Swirling Tree not only repaired her meridians, but also strengthened them for her. Wen Xi felt that her meridians were much stronger and wider. She was really grateful for this experience, which was considered a blessing in disguise.
Xiao Zhu; "That's good. During this year of coma, were you conscious? Did you feel any pain?"

He was afraid that the recovery process of Wenxi Meridian would be painful.
"I do have consciousness," Wen Xi nodded, "It's just that they are all inexplicable pictures."
Not knowing what he thought of, Wen Xi narrowed his eyes and the smile on his lips slowly disappeared.
She turned her head and looked at the clouds in the distance, and said softly: "It's nothing. Speaking of which, it was just a nap."
But in that dream, I vaguely saw many scenes that I shouldn't have seen...
After a moment, Wen Xi turned his eyes slightly and fell on Xiao Zhu again, with a smile on his face again——
Wen Xi: "Let's not talk about this anymore. I just saw you planning to lock the yard. Why...are you planning to run away?"
The corner of Wen Xi's mouth twitched slightly: "Then I'm curious. Uncle Leng doesn't agree. How are you going to get out of Qingyun Taoist Academy? Uncle Mo's formations are not vegetarian."
Xiao Zhu blinked: "I still have the leave request note that senior brother gave me last time."
Leng Qianshuang is busy, and Ling Jue is usually responsible for managing the trivial matters in Zixiaofeng. He often hands over the blank discharge application form while asking Leng Qianshuang to sign the jade slip.
After so many years, Ling Jue had one or two hundred leave application slips in his hand.In front of the Hen Valley, Ling Jue hugged him and said, "Good junior brother, come here, senior brother, I will give you all these, you must come out alive." Then there were 200 more discharge application forms in Xiao Yao's space spirit treasure.
Later, Xiao Zhuo did come out of Thousand Marks Valley alive, and Ling Jue came to find him again.
"Junior brother, my good junior brother, I admit that I was a little too impulsive at the time. Look at this leave request, is it, what is that..."
Xiao Zhu finally returned a hundred pieces, keeping half for himself.
At this moment, Xiao Zhu sold Ling Jue without any hesitation.
She still had to learn more from her senior brother, although the master would never let her have such trouble.
